title: Report record ingestion
responsibility: Applies one sanitized record to a report and imports evidence files when needed.

inputs.name: reportIngest.report
inputs.description: The Report to update, mutated in place and returned as the same object; ReportRepository.record only passes a run whose state is active. Its checks, evidence, findings and coverage arrays must exist for the record kinds that write to them.

examples.title: Checkout flow
examples.summary: Desktop checkout passes; the mobile layout is still under review.

inputs.name: reportIngest.record
inputs.description: The record to apply: data is first passed through cleanData, so strings are sanitized and keys that end in secret, password, token or apiKey, or that are named authorization or cookie, become '[REDACTED]'. summary stores String(data.text) (a missing text becomes 'undefined'), acceptance stores data.items as given, check, finding, coverage and evidence replace the item with the same id and append it at the end, heartbeat changes only updatedAt, and no field is validated here.

data.text: Desktop checkout passes; the mobile layout is still under review.

inputs.name: reportIngest.directory
inputs.description: The report run directory, the value ReportRepository.directory returns for the run id; only evidence records use it, writing the image or audio bytes to its assets subfolder under a SHA-256-based file name. The path is not checked here, so an evidence record whose directory cannot be created or written rejects.

outputs.name: reportIngest
outputs.description: Promise that resolves to the same report object passed in, mutated in place, with updatedAt set to the current time as an ISO string. For evidence, the file is imported from the unsanitized record.data.path, path and storage are dropped, the generated file, mediaType, mimeType and (for WAV) durationSeconds overwrite same-named caller fields, and category and status default to 'Evidence' and 'not-proven' when falsy.

examples.title: Checkout flow
examples.summary: Desktop checkout passes; the mobile layout is still under review.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects when the input breaks the declared types, such as a missing report, record or record.data, or a missing checks, evidence, findings or coverage array for the record kind being applied. Those fields are read without guards, so well-typed input never raises it.

errors.name: Error (Node fs error from lstat or readFile)
errors.description: Rejects with the Node fs error when data.path cannot be inspected or read, for example ENOENT for a missing file or EACCES for a path that cannot be accessed. A missing data.path is passed as the string 'undefined', so it normally fails with ENOENT.

errors.name: Error: Evidence symlinks are not accepted
errors.description: Rejects when data.path itself is a symbolic link, because lstat does not follow the final path component. Symbolic links in parent directories are followed and are not rejected.

errors.name: Error: Invalid evidence file or size
errors.description: Rejects when data.path is not a regular file or is larger than 50,000,000 bytes, and an empty image file fails with the same message from the image check.

errors.name: Error: Invalid audio file or size
errors.description: Rejects an audio source (.wav, .mp3, .m4a or .ogg) whose bytes are empty. Files over 50,000,000 bytes are rejected earlier with the invalid evidence message.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV audio
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source shorter than 44 bytes or without the RIFF and WAVE signatures.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV container length
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source whose RIFF size field plus 8 does not equal the file length.

errors.name: Error: Truncated WAV chunk
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source in which a chunk's declared length runs past the end of the RIFF container.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV chunk boundary
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source whose chunk walk does not end exactly at the end of the RIFF container.

errors.name: Error: Unsupported WAV audio format
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source that is neither PCM (format 1) nor 32-bit float (format 3), has a channel count outside 1 to 8, or has a sample rate outside 4000 to 384000 Hz.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV format
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source whose fmt chunk is shorter than 16 bytes.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV sample format
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source whose bits per sample are not 8, 16, 24 or 32, or whose block align or bytes-per-second field does not match its channels, bits and sample rate.

errors.name: Error: Invalid WAV audio data length
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source whose data chunk length is not a multiple of the block align.

errors.name: Error: WAV format and audio data are required
errors.description: Rejects a .wav source that has no fmt chunk or no data chunk, or whose data chunk is empty.

errors.name: Error: Audio content does not match its filename
errors.description: Rejects a .mp3, .ogg or .m4a source whose bytes fail the format check for its extension; .wav sources skip this check and use the WAV errors instead.

errors.name: Error: Unsupported evidence format
errors.description: Rejects a non-audio source whose lowercase extension is not .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp, such as .gif, .pdf or a name without an extension.

errors.name: Error: Evidence must be a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image
errors.description: Rejects an image source whose bytes do not start with the PNG, JPEG or WebP signature.

errors.name: Error: Image content does not match its filename
errors.description: Rejects an image source whose detected format differs from its extension; a .jpeg name is accepted for JPEG content.

errors.name: Error (Node fs error from mkdir or writeFile)
errors.description: Rejects with the Node fs error when the assets subfolder of the report directory cannot be created or the asset file cannot be written, for example EACCES, ENOTDIR or ENOSPC.
